scientific_integrity: All analytical statements use the state-preserving gate reset operator. General proof is in RESULT.md and verification code supplies finite approximations only; no independent audit or certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: First derivative at zero reset rate only; stationary initial gate, bounded uniform Brownian diffusion and single independently switching boundary. The result does not establish optimal finite positive rate or apply to gate-reset protocols. Independent priority confirmation is outstanding.
title: Sharp weak-resetting threshold with an independently switching Brownian gate
